text_block_list.text: While walking around the academy, I spotted Mejiro Dober engrossed in a book...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I see... Efficient fat burning
starts with improving one's diet...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wha, huh, wha!? Don't just pop up out of nowhere...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No, that's...
Well, it's not wrong, but... ugh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Keep it a secret that I was reading this, okay?
Especially from Ryan and the others...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Keep it a secret that I was reading this, okay?
Especially from Ryan and the others...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...They'd probably try to help if they knew,
but I didn't want to burden them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's just... when I'm on my own, I'm not even
confident I'm doing it right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, geez...!
Do I really have to spell everything out for you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So... basically... if,
you've got some free time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Look over this together with me as part of training, will ya? ...Seems like that'd be more efficient anyway.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I'm gonna use this book as a guide to try it out, so... um, come with me, okay?

And so, the diet guidance began,
and Mejiro Dober seems to have seen real results!
